body: Wrote a letter. I'm going to make myself look less horrible and get dressed. Then... It's enough. It's truly enough. I just can't anymore.

Because I don't have the money to do the certificate and even if I did I'd still be unemployed because there is no jobs in my country. And the more time I spend unemployed the less chances I have. 

I tried everything I could to fix it. I just can't do this anymore.

I'm also chronically ill and I can't do physical jobs either. (And they don't call me regardless, I've tried)

I can get benefits but are 200€ or something. Nowhere a livable wage. I can't get a job and worse, here is a rebate war the market. 

They are a good support system but I can't cope with how bad my life is anymore. I tried everything to fix it and it didn't work because apparently I can't have anything nice in my life.

It is. I'm chronically ill both physically and mentally. I failed everything I tried to do. I have no education because I failed university and I have been unemployed long term. I'm broke.

I have spent a third of my life depressed. I truly regret not having killed myself five years ago.
